title: P0-1 林晚造型A：用这张 → 必须弹确认；不换=无写请求；换=写请求假成功 → 撤销

steps.js: for (let i=0;i<80;i++){ if (document.querySelector('[aria-label="造型 A 设定图候选"]')) return 'ok '+i; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); } return 'timeout: '+document.body.innerText.slice(0,200)

window.__w=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="造型 A 设定图候选"] .hub-candw')].find(w=>!w.querySelector('.hub-cand.on') && /种子 101/.test(w.innerText)); const w=window.__w(); return w? w.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ') : 'no seed101'

steps.clickAt: (()=>{const b=[...window.__w().querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/用这张/.test(x.innerText)); b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]})()

(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.hub-toast-undo')].find(x=>/撤销/.test(x.innerText)); if(!b) return [null,null]; const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]})()

title: P0-2 / P1-1 画布 ep07（重启前 11 镜都会兜底显示旧草图）

steps.js: const sc=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+200 && /auto|scroll/.test(getComputedStyle(e).overflowY)); for (const s of sc){ for(let y=0;y<s.scrollHeight;y+=500){ s.scrollTop=y; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); } s.scrollTop=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('img')].map(i=>decodeURIComponent(i.currentSrc||i.src).replace(/.*src=/,'')).filter(s=>/renders|frames/.test(s)); const draft=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /草图/.test(e.innerText||'')).length; const vid=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /视频 \d+ 版待选/.test(e.innerText||'')).length; return {oldFrames: imgs.filter(s=>/images\/frames\//.test(s)), imgs: imgs.slice(0,15), draftLabels:draft, videoPending:vid}
